test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term is related to third term.

 RK46 : TJ51 :: PJ129 : RI134 :: SR53 : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• **Second letter ⇒ (1) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.**
 
• Number ⇒ (5) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• RK46 : TJ51

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/452e93aa444cff479d9cd6da23e15bca40a2169081c736e3d26847b633a3f738.png] 

And,

 
• PJ129 : RI134

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc1aed317611f54dab9bb4eb7e984632573521a93d56eefd8bb47b951927011b.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• SR53 : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86ef925e500f1fe1522d0995ec8fca5d00bd339293397516825011bc750ef313.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "UQ58".

e0:T
